what: Do contract records from before the April 2022 switch carry a UEI on USAspending.gov today? One small sample, checked once.
source: USAspending.gov download service, POST https://api.usaspending.gov/api/v2/download/transactions/ (no key or account)
reading: Every sampled FY2010 transaction carries a UEI, so USAspending has filled in UEIs on old records; a company's vendor_id is UEI-based before and after the switch whenever its records got a UEI. One agency and five days only: a check, not a measurement.
